summary: Parker-Hannifin filed a preliminary 424B5 prospectus supplement for senior notes due 2030, 2032 and 2036, with coupons and principal amounts left blank in the preliminary version. Net proceeds, alongside a concurrent US$2.4 billion US dollar note offering and cash on hand, will repay borrowings under a 364-Day Credit Agreement drawn to fund the previously announced acquisition of Filtration Group Corporation (FGC). The notes are unsecured senior obligations ranking pari passu with existing senior unsecured debt, with a 101% change-of-control put and Euronext Dublin GEM listing sought. This is routine acquisition-related debt financing, not a new special situation; watch pricing, oversubscription and any change to FGC deal timing.
